name: search_repositories
description: Search repositories by keywords and filter them by language, topic, owner, stars, archive status, and creation date.

query.description: Keywords or phrases to search for in repository names and descriptions.

archived.description: Whether to include archived repositories. Set false to exclude archived repositories.

created_after.description: Lower bound for repository creation date, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

created_before.description: Upper bound for repository creation date, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

limit.description: Maximum number of repositories to return.

include_forks.description: Whether forked repositories should be included.
